successCriteria.description: Create `src/modules/policy/policy.model.ts` exporting a `LeavePolicy` interface with exactly these fields: id, policyName, leaveType (typed as `LeaveType` imported from `src/shared/types/leave.types.ts`), entitlementDays, accrualRate, maxAccumulation, minimumNoticeDays, requiresManagerApproval, isActive, allowNegativeBalance, maxConsecutiveDays, fiscalYear, createdAt, updatedAt.
Create `src/modules/policy/policy.model.ts` exporting a `LeavePolicyQueryParams` DTO (interface or type) for querying policies.
Create `src/modules/policy/policy.repository.ts` exporting an `ILeavePolicyRepository` interface with method signatures: findById, findByLeaveType, findActivePolicies, create, update, delete.

Create `src/modules/policy/policy.repository.ts` exporting a `LeavePolicyRepository` class implementing `ILeavePolicyRepository`, using the `pg.Pool` from `src/shared/db/connection.ts` for all database operations.
Include Jest unit tests in `tests/unit/modules/policy/` covering the model (field existence/types) and repository methods (mocked pg Pool).

constraints: All database access must go through the repository pattern (GP-001) — the `LeavePolicyRepository` class is the sole point of database interaction for policies.
The `LeavePolicy` interface must import `LeaveType` from `src/shared/types/leave.types.ts` (Phase 1 dependency) — no redefinition of the enum.
The `LeavePolicyRepository` must import `pool` from `src/shared/db/connection.ts` — no new connection pools or inline database drivers.
Strict TypeScript: no `any` types, no implicit any, strict null checks — use `unknown` with type guards where needed.
Follow the existing module file-naming convention: `policy.model.ts`, `policy.repository.ts` under `src/modules/policy/`.
Tests must use Jest and be placed under `tests/unit/modules/policy/` mirroring the source structure.
outOfScope: Route handlers and Fastify registration (`policy.routes.ts`) — deferred to Phase 8.
Module barrel export (`src/modules/policy/index.ts`) — deferred to Phase 8.
Database migrations (Knex) for the `leave_policies` table — not part of this phase; the repository assumes the table already exists.
Audit record creation (GP-002) — audit logging is a service-layer concern, not a repository concern in this phase.
RBAC enforcement (GP-005) — enforced at the middleware/route layer, not in the model or repository.
Input validation (GP-003) — validation happens at the API boundary (controller/route), not in the model or repository layer.
